meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能把 BAM 转成标准化的 bigWig 覆盖轨道,做相关性、PCA、指纹等质控,并在 TSS 或峰区画热图和 profile 图,覆盖 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 等实验。
howto.when: 当你要求把 BAM 转成 bigWig、做 ChIP-seq 质控,或生成 TSS/峰区热图等 NGS 分析时,它会接管。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can convert BAM files to normalized bigWig coverage tracks, run QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and draw heatmaps or profiles around TSS and peaks for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq and ATAC-seq.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to convert BAM to bigWig, run ChIP-seq QC, or draw heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks and similar NGS tasks.
